rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズ

relations.text: HPEの旧エンタープライズ・サービス事業と統合してDXCが誕生。税務契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: DXC was formed from HPE's former Enterprise Services business; tax matters agreement

source.label: HPE 10-K(2025年10月期)
source.quote: In connection with the Everett Transaction and the Seattle Transaction, the Company entered into a Tax Matters Agreement with DXC and Micro Focus respectively

companies.name: コカ・コーラFEMSA
companies.sub: 飲料ボトラー(メキシコ)

relations.text: 2015年から全地域のITサービスをDXCに委託
relations.text_en: Has used DXC for technology services across its territories since 2015

source.label: Coca-Cola FEMSA 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Since July 2015, we have entered into certain agreements with DXC Technology (formerly Hewlett Packard) for the provision of various technology services across all of our territories.

relations.text: システム統合・大規模導入でDXCと提携
relations.text_en: Deployment agreement with DXC for integration and rollout

source.label: Alpha Modus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Alpha Modus entered into a strategic enterprise deployment agreement with DXC Technology

companies.name: バンザイ・インターナショナル

relations.text: 動画サービスOpenReelの企業顧客の一社としてDXCを挙げる

source.quote: OpenReel's enterprise customer base includes global organizations, such as Bristol Myers Squibb, Ingram Micro, DXC Technology

source.quote: such as Accenture, Atos, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte, DXC Technology and Kyndryl
